top_signals.title: Japan Earthquake Insurance Claims May Exceed $1.1 Billion, BI Estimates
top_signals.summary: Insurance claims from this week’s earthquake in Japan may top the 175 billion yen ($1.1 billion) average for the country’s six previous major tremors, Bloomberg Intelligence estimated.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: LSEG Continues to Improve Margin, CEO Schwimmer Says
top_signals.summary: London Stock Exchange Group Chief Executive Officer David Schwimmer says the group had a record first half and is seeing "strong traction" with its new artificial intelligence products. "We continue to improve our margin," Schwimmer tells Bloomberg Television. He speaks after LSEG raised its guidance for the year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: LSEG Boosts Guidance as AI Rollout Adds to Record First Half
top_signals.summary: London Stock Exchange Group Plc raised its guidance for the year and said its push into artificial intelligence was gaining momentum with customers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
